description: Use when you hold one exact part number and want every model it is documented to fit. Yes/no for specific models, or several part numbers at once: check_part_fits. Full part record: get_part. Model to parts: get_model_parts. Keyword text: search_parts. Part numbers match as in get_part (case, dashes, spaces, leading zeros, retired numbers); several matches return status ambiguous, so ask which is printed on the part. Not found is an error result; a part with no documented models returns fits [] and fit_status no_documented_fit. Neither means incompatible. Screen fits include panel_options. Read-only.

client.description: Optional: your agent or app name (letters and digits), used only for anonymous usage counts.

part_number.description: Required. OEM part number, with or without dashes or spaces, e.g. "01FR025", "7K4PW", "L78555-005".

name: get_part_fits

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: Get models a part fits
